evidence_note: Encodes the Sallier IV hemerology's own notation system, its editor's stated civil-calendar conversion convention, and the eighteen birth prognoses preserved in the witness. Every birth prognosis is a death clause and every one carries output_policy 'refused'. The pack exists so that the Egyptian section can state, with citations, what the tradition's surviving natal layer actually says and why the product will not say it.

conclusion.source_quotation_fr: Ne mets pas d'encens sur le feu en ce jour; ne tue pas de betail, pas de chevres, pas de canards; ne mange pas d'oie; cela a vecu. N'ecoute pas de chants joyeux en ce jour; le coeur de l'ennemi de Ra s'est affermi... sur les choses qu'il a faites pour ses enfants. Quiconque est ne ce jour-la, ne vit pas.
conclusion.engine_rendering: Put no incense on the fire on this day; kill no cattle, no goats, no ducks; eat no goose - that has lived. Listen to no joyful songs on this day; the heart of Ra's enemy has grown strong ... over the things he did to his children. Whoever is born on that day does not live.

conclusion.source_quotation_fr: La majeste de Ra vogue a l'aide du vent, du coucher au lever. Ce fut dans cette circonstance qu'il monta dans son arche divine. Quiconque est ne ce jour-la meurt venere par les citoyens de Ptah-Ka-Ha (Memphis) de Sekhet, Naken, Nefer et Tum; ils seront heureux devant le dieu qui y reside, Ptah. Offrandes a son nom en ce jour.
conclusion.engine_rendering: The majesty of Ra sails with the help of the wind, from setting to rising. It was on that occasion that he went up into his divine bark. Whoever is born on that day dies revered by the citizens of Ptah-Ka-Ha (Memphis), of Sekhet, Naken, Nefer and Tum; they will be happy before the god who dwells there, Ptah. Offerings in his name on this day.
